title: Largest effective charge in a row
statement:
Which atom generally has the strongest effective nuclear attraction on its outer electrons among Na, Mg, Si and Cl?

[_]{a}

explanations: It generally has the greatest valence effective nuclear charge of these four.
Its proton count is lower than Si and Cl.
Its attraction trend is stronger than Na or Mg but below Cl in this comparison.

hints: Look farthest right among the choices.
solution: All occupy Period 3. Added same-shell electrons shield incompletely. Look farthest right among the choices. It generally has the greatest valence effective nuclear charge of these four.
